title.zh: 概率分布 · 随机性也有形状
title.en: Probability Distributions · Randomness Has a Shape

description.zh: 每个结果的概率排成条形，就是分布：条形高度是 P(X=x)，全部加起来等于 1。条形的重心是期望 E[X]，条形离重心的加权平方距离是方差；右尾的面积回答“至少这么大”的概率。
description.en: Probabilities arranged by outcome form a distribution: each bar's height is P(X=x), and all bars sum to 1. The bars' balance point is the expectation E[X]; their probability-weighted squared distance from it is the variance, and the right tail's area answers 'at least this big'.

label.zh: 概率排成条形就是分布
label.en: Probabilities lined up are a distribution

reason.zh: 每个结果的概率就是一根条形的高度，全部条形加起来等于 1——分布不是新概念，是把概率按结果排成的形状。
reason.en: Each outcome's probability is one bar's height, and all bars sum to 1 — a distribution is not a new idea, it is probabilities arranged by outcome.

label.zh: 条形变细变多，趋向钟形曲线
label.en: Finer, more numerous bars tend toward the bell curve

reason.zh: 对称预设的条形已经是钟形；把条形变细、变多，离散的分布就趋向连续的高斯曲线——同一随机现象，两种表示。
reason.en: The symmetric preset's bars already form a bell; make the bars finer and more numerous and the discrete distribution tends toward the continuous Gaussian curve — one phenomenon, two representations.

label.zh: 方差就是从分布里算出来的离散程度
label.en: Variance is the spread computed from the distribution

reason.zh: 方差不是凭空来的数：拿分布的每根条形，按概率加权平均它离重心的平方距离，就得到方差。
reason.en: Variance is not a number from nowhere: take every bar of the distribution, average its squared distance from the balance point weighted by probability, and you get variance.

title.en: Why does randomness have a shape?

ask.zh: 每个结果的概率都已知时，把它们按结果排成一排，会看到什么？
ask.en: When every outcome's probability is known, what do you see if you line them up by outcome?

ask.zh: 条形的高度、重心、离散程度各由什么决定？右尾的面积回答什么问题？
ask.en: What decides the bars' heights, balance point, and spread? What question does the right tail's area answer?

ask.zh: 把条形变细变多，对称分布会趋向什么形状？为什么说那是同一现象的连续表示？
ask.en: As the bars get finer and more numerous, what shape does a symmetric distribution tend toward, and why is that the continuous representation of the same phenomenon?

reveal.zh: 每个结果的概率排成条形，就是分布。条形的重心是期望，条形离重心的加权平方距离是方差。
reveal.en: Probabilities arranged by outcome form a distribution. The bars' balance point is the expectation, and their probability-weighted squared distance from it is the variance.
